<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Short Dodo 73</title>
<style>
/* Short Dodo 73 by Yaya12085 — https://uiverse.io/Yaya12085/short-dodo-73 */
button {
  border: none;
  display: flex;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  background-color: #488aec;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  vertical-align: middle;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  user-select: none;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px #488aec31, 0 2px 4px -1px #488aec17;
  transition: all .6s ease;
}

button:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px #488aec4f, 0 4px 6px -2px #488aec17;
}

button:focus,button:active {
  opacity: .85;
  box-shadow: none;
}

button svg {
  width: 1.25rem;
  height: 1.25rem;
}
</style>
</head>

  </svg>

</button>
